title: Mary Queen of Scots to the Duke of Norfolk, 'the 20th' [Feb or Mar 1570], BL Cotton MS Caligula C II f. 74r

steps.what: BL IIIF manifest found via searcharchives; 1024-px tiles stitched to full resolution.
Tomokiyo's key checked on f. 66r against its contemporary decipherment.
Key applied to 23 line strips; all lines read, five nomenclator signs and a few groups open.
Content dated after Moray's murder (Jan 1570): Morton rumour, Lord Talbot, Elizabeth's blame.

Novelty re-examined. G. Lasry (21 Sept 2026): on cryptiana 'undeciphered' means no interlinear or nearby deciphered copy, not unsolved; unsolved material is on the unsolved page. The key was available (Tomokiyo); the contribution is the transcription and the reading.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): reading copied from NOTES.md to texts/f74r_decryption.md; no sign-level transcription of the cipher exists in the folder (the reading was made on the image strips)

outcome.method_basis: Tomokiyo's key for the Mary-Norfolk series, reconstructed from ff. 66/69/75 of the same volume (Cotton Caligula C II) and published on cryptiana mary.htm with a partial overlay of f. 74r, was checked on f. 66r against its decipherment and applied to 23 line strips from the new BL IIIF images.
outcome.notes: Open: five unkeyed signs, two groups in line 1, stained end of line 4, single words.

texts.label: Mary Queen of Scots to Norfolk, 'the 20th' [Feb or Mar 1570], BL Cotton MS Caligula C II f. 74r
texts.summary: Written after Moray's murder at Linlithgow (23 Jan 1570): Mary tells Norfolk she will undertake nothing unless it is safe for them both, urges him to write to the Bishop of Ross and to act through his sister Scrope or others, says Elizabeth blames her for Moray's death, reports rumours of Morton and Lord Talbot, and begs him not to risk writing in his own hand. No sign-level transcription of the cipher exists; the reading was made on the image strips.
